metadata.description: agentPacks plugins generated for Cursor Team Marketplace import.

plugins.name: dotnet
plugins.description: The C# and .NET pack: canonical build, implementation, test and review standards consumed by Squad.

plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Blocks the git commands that destroy work an agent cannot get back: reset --hard, clean -fd, push --force, branch -D, and checkout or restore over the working tree.

plugins.name: pack-check
plugins.description: Detects the repository stack at session start and offers to install the language pack that supplies its required build and test skills.

plugins.name: rust
plugins.description: The Rust pack: canonical Cargo build, implementation, test and review standards consumed by Squad.

plugins.name: security
plugins.description: User-invoked /security-audit: recon, parallel hunting, and adversarial validation of exploitable trust-boundary failures. Per-change OWASP stays in Squad.

plugins.name: squad
plugins.description: User-invoked /squad, /squad-review, and /scenarios: the main agent mediates planning, runs plan-bound implementation and verification, fans dual-axis reviewers, and merges at most two fix rounds before an uncommitted hand-off. /scenarios writes docs/smoke/<slug>.md from changed code.

plugins.name: typescript
plugins.description: The TypeScript pack: canonical tsc build, test and review standards consumed by Squad.
